response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems experience with event-driven architectures and real-time systems, but lacks direct exposure to multi-agent AI systems, fintech infrastructure, or regulated commercial environments. His recent work at re:cinq involves AI-agent tooling but not full production agentic frameworks or fintech applications. Leadership experience exists but not at the scale or fintech-specific domain required.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems and event-driven architecture experience (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Proven ability to scale engineering teams and improve processes (e.g., RIDE Capital, Altom Consulting)
Hands-on with real-time systems and performance optimization (e.g., Dunnhumby, WatchUp Apple TV top ranking)
concerns: No demonstrated experience building or operating multi-agent AI systems in production
Limited fintech or credit-risk domain expertise (e.g., working-capital, trade decisioning)
No track record in regulated commercial environments or AI-system reliability at fintech scale
